record.paper_title: Negative Circles in Signed Graphs: A Problem Collection
record.context_brief: counts of negative fixed-length cycles in complete bipartite graphs
record.original_question: Characterize, for fixed r,s and fixed circle length, the possible numbers of negative circles of that length among all signatures of the complete bipartite graph K_{r,s}.

evidence.quote: CN2. Characterize the possible numbers of negative circles of a fixed length of all signatures of Kr,s.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A signed graph is a pair $(G,\sigma)$ where $G=(V,E)$ is a graph and $\sigma:E\to\{+1,-1\}$ assigns a sign to each edge. The sign of a cycle (circle) $C$ in $G$ is the product $\prod_{e\in E(C)}\sigma(e)$; the cycle is called negative if this product is $-1$.

Let $K_{r,s}$ denote the complete bipartite graph with parts of sizes $r$ and $s$. For any signature $\sigma$ of $K_{r,s}$ and any even integer $\ell\geq 4$ with $\ell\leq 2\min(r,s)$, let
$$N_\ell(\sigma)=\#\{\text{negative cycles of length }\ell\text{ in }(K_{r,s},\sigma)\}.$$

Problem. Fix integers $r,s\geq 2$ and an admissible even cycle length $\ell$. Determine the set
$$\mathcal{S}(r,s,\ell)=\{\,N_\ell(\sigma)\,:\,\sigma\in\{+1,-1\}^{E(K_{r,s})}\,\},$$
i.e., characterize exactly which nonnegative integers occur as the number of negative $\ell$-cycles over all signatures of $K_{r,s}$.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem appears in a published problem collection on negative circles in signed graphs and is listed as one of several open characterization questions. Available results give partial information (e.g., dimensions of negative-cycle vector spaces for $K_n$ and $K_{r,s}$ via work of Popescu and Tomescu), but no complete characterization of the possible counts of negative cycles of a fixed length over all signatures of $K_{r,s}$ has been reported.
